_comment: Shipped to PLUGIN INSTALLS only. This repo's own dev hooks live in .claude/settings.json
and are unrelated: a contributor working in the checkout is not running the plugin.
ONE HOOK, and deliberately only one. The early-warning freshness check is the only thing
here that a user cannot reasonably be asked to remember, and it is silent when current.
The repo's other two gates are NOT wired: require_commit_before_message.sh blocks a tool
call when the tree is dirty, and no-heredoc-source.sh blocks a class of Bash command.
Both are good rules and both are somebody's opinion about how their repo should work --
installing a review harness must not silently start refusing a stranger's commands. They
ship in the plugin for anyone who wants them; see the README.
--hook never touches the network: it serves a cached verdict and refreshes detached, so
session startup is never blocked on a lookup. --plugin reads the commit Claude Code
recorded for this install; with no answer it exits 2 and says nothing.
